resources.string: Choose apps or the whole phone for this conversation. Authorization lasts until you turn it off. Locking, restarting or losing the system service only pauses operation; it does not erase authorization.

Enabling permits this conversation to observe and operate selected apps and share future screenshots with its current and subsequently selected models, without per-image confirmation. Local models process on-device; network models may receive private screen content. Ordinary attachments are excluded and conversation tool permissions still apply.
